entities.summary: W Las Vegas is a luxury suite hotel that is owned and operated by MGM Resorts International, and is part of Marriott International's W Hotels brand. It is located within the Mandalay Bay complex on the Las Vegas Strip in Paradise, Nevada, United States. The hotel is 43 stories and includes 1,117 rooms. It opened on December 17, 2003, as THEhotel at Mandalay Bay.
